name: Barbell Bench Press
cues: Set your eyes under the bar and grip wide enough for vertical forearms
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and keep them pinned
Touch the bar to your lower chest with elbows slightly tucked
Drive your feet into the floor as you press
Finish with the bar stacked over your shoulders
